sequence.action: After full live release: recheck source UTXO, network/sync, fees and keys locally; construct and verify one funding transaction allocating 1,650,000,000 sompi to the trial sponsor; retain signed bytes/hash; submit once and confirm selected-chain acceptance.

Build/sign/check the harmless fixed-lane activate operation if inactive; submit once, wait for actual confirmed active inclusion and capture/verify a fresh seed. The preflight inactive capture is not a seed.

Build bootstrap from the verified seed and actual sponsor UTXO; confirm actual covenant ID. Build initialize preserving exactly 100,000,000 state rent and reviewed lane-restricted successor; capture both acceptances and create the zero-liability checkpoint.

Recheck initialized state and fund the actual 1,000,000,000-sompi delegate deposit. Confirm, capture all accepted lane activity and freeze deposit target A with actual lineage. Retain target SHA/bytes independently on B.

Recheck actual Secure L40S/storage quote <=USD5 planning; create exactly one Pod with the pinned immutable image. Read actual image/resources/creation/workspace. Generate a NEW <=7200-second lease, preserve the old lease, add exactly workloadScope/trial/packagePolicySha256 to the ten normal fields; set readable ownership and arm the existing sole B guard. Confirm exact scope/unused ledger/fresh heartbeat; start only with >3960 seconds left.

Approve B-local A target and upload public bundle. Verify receipt A on trusted B CPU, then prepare fully signed native settlement A, all scripts/mass/compute/fees and selected-chain anchor window; submit once, confirm and checkpoint.

Alice uses actual registered deposit reference and reviewed public parameters/own role backup to produce fresh credit and invalid/valid transfer operations. Publish, capture from A proof endpoint including interim native settlement, freeze B, approve on B, prove once, CPU-verify, prepare/confirm native settlement B and checkpoint.

The operator-controlled Bob role uses its own backup/current public state and fixed native recipient to produce the authorized exit. Publish, capture from B proof endpoint, freeze C, prove once and CPU-verify. Build/verify/confirm C settlement with the genuine C receipt to issue the restricted permission.

Build/check/sign payout from actual permission/reserve/sponsor inputs. Bob receives >=450,000,000 sompi including rent, reserve change is exactly 600,000,000 and state rent stays separate. Confirm payout; capture from C proof endpoint including issuance/payout; freeze/prove/CPU-verify D and confirm final native settlement/checkpoint.

Retain every candidate/partial/receipt and diagnostics; B revalidates external hashes/receipts and CUDA matching-process evidence. Confirm provider EXITED on success or failure. Delete this attempt Pod/storage only after verified external preservation and confirm deletion; record actual billed runtime/cost, distinguish estimates.

perSpendGates: Fully signed exact transaction with all native inputs executed; actual script version, lane, covenant/outpoint lineage, compute budgets, storage/compute/transient mass and integer fees checked.
Fresh selected-chain/UTXO spentness and exact receipt endpoint/seq; selected parent blue-score distance must satisfy native finality window. Never rewrite the proven endpoint.

Retain exact transaction ID/bytes before one scoped submitTransaction call with allowOrphan=false; no historical run-trial scripts. Ambiguous transport outcome requires read-only reconciliation, never automatic rebroadcast.
Keep principal/state rent/permission rent/fees separate. Do not expand the 500M fee planning allocation or use reserve principal for fees.
On reorg, stale anchor, failed proof, unsupported input size, depleted fee budget or loss of independent guard: stop and preserve last selected checkpoint; no retry/extension within this attempt.
success: Four new actual-input receipts with connected exact journals verified independently on B; native permission issuance/payout uses the new C receipt.
Actual Bob >=450M output, 600M reserve and 100M state-rent outpoints; final D reserve600M/private600M/pending0/unpaid0 confirmed on selected chain.
Native underpayment/recipient/diversion and spent-input replay rejection observed with specific semantic/cryptographic errors; resource failures are not successful negatives.
Matching-process CUDA for every batch; durable B preservation; confirmed provider stop/deletion and actual cost records.
limitations: One owner-operated native node and trusted B/root/controller; separate verification processes reuse the reviewed implementation.
Small experimental note tree, one pending exit, one selected reserve larger than exit; no production privacy claim.
Fresh actual outpoints/seed/targets/receipts/signed native transactions depend on future acceptance; none are invented or replaced with fixtures.
No new ZK proof, wallet proof, funding, native broadcast, GPU rental or provider mutation occurred in preflight.
Owner explicitly authorizes existing-operator custody of Bob for this test; independent user custody/recovery is not demonstrated.
releaseModel: One subsequent owner release may authorize the entire listed bounded sequence; advance through successful checkpoints without new permission rounds, and stop on an unmet condition. No live action is authorized by this preflight.
